# hibob Provider

Interact with hibob.

## Example Usage

```terraform

# Configuration-based authentication
provider "hibob" {
  username = "myusername"
  password = "myverysecretpassword123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for hibob API.
- `username` (String) Username for hibob API.
